business: RizqPure Halal Collagen (UK online supplement brand)
why_not: It just says 'halal-certified' and never says by who, so I can't be sure it's really halal. And £18 a month on collagen for myself is hard to justify when the family budget comes first.

Collagen for my joints after training is something I'd actually use, and £18 one-off is fair. But it says 'halal-certified' and doesn't tell me who by, and I don't put a supplement in my body until I know the certifying body.
